speaker: penny
text: I'll talk to Leonard.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You will?

speaker: penny
text: Yes. If it means that much to you, you should go.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, Penny, thank you!

speaker: penny
text: You're welcome.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Since I rarely hug, I'm relying on your expertise regarding duration.

speaker: penny
text: I think we're there.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, good. Bye-bye.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You know what? Even though I don't have a girlfriend, I can still have a good time on Valentine's Day.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Trust me, you can't. I've tried.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: No, no, no, I'm going to have a me day. First I'm going to go to one of those spas in Koreatown, take a steam and get a massage. Then I'm going to stop at a pet store and get licked by puppies.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, I need to talk to you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right, my friend. Would you like some cholermus?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Some what?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Cholermus. It's a traditional Swiss breakfast dish. I'm preparing my gastrointestinal system for the exotic cuisine of Switzerland.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You're not going to Switzerland!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, but I am. Didn't Penny tell you the good news?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: She told me that you went behind my back to guilt her into letting you go instead of her.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes, that good news.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, forget it. I was the one who was invited, I get to decide who goes with me, and it's Penny, not you!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Howard, could you lower the lights? I have a short PowerPoint presentation.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't need to see your presentation. This discussion is over!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That's a somewhat ambiguous response. Am I going or not?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, at this point, I would go by myself before I would take you. Yeah, really.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Really?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well then, you leave me no alternative. From this moment forward, we can be roommates, but we will no longer be friends.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I don't think you're fully aware of the ramifications here, Leonard.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Why don't you enlighten me?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: With the friendship clause of our roommate agreement nullified you are no longer entitled to accompany me to go swimming at Bill Gates' house should I be invited.
